deepseek_columns.ai_logs_output: return FULL raw `dmidecode -t 32` output filtered to the `Reserved` value for that section (raw text, verbatim) so the user can diff against expected; judge correctness/persistence after reboot.

historical_reviews.deepseek: YES; searches formatted text but does not prove six raw bytes, offsets or zero values.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION / CHANGED; correctly adds raw length/offset validation but lowers capability for package/reboot readiness.

original_test_intent: Verify that the six Reserved bytes in each applicable SMBIOS Type 32 System Boot Information structure are all 00h and remain unchanged after reboot, without confusing them with Boot Status or additional data.
original_method: Capture complete raw and decoded Type 32 records, verify structure length and exact reserved-byte offsets, require six explicit zero bytes, preserve Boot Status separately, and repeat byte-level validation after approved reboot.
manual_activity: A user approves the reboot and Type 32 applicability policy; raw byte extraction and zero validation require no manual observation.
required_inputs: Applicable SMBIOS version and Type 32 minimum length
Policy for absent or multiple Type 32 records
safety_requirements: Use read-only SMBIOS collection; never write firmware or boot configuration.
Verify record type/length before reading exact reserved offsets and retain all six raw bytes.
Keep Boot Status and any additional data separate from reserved bytes.
Require reboot approval/recovery; stop on truncation, ambiguity or boot failure and do not auto-retry.
agent_execution_scope: Identify each Type 32 record, verify length, extract the six reserved bytes, require 00h values and compare exact bytes pre/post reboot.
Report missing, duplicate, truncated or non-zero evidence without issuing PASS/FAIL.
engineer_actions: Assess any non-zero or ambiguous firmware record and issue the verdict.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: The Type 32 target is correct, but grep Reserved cannot prove exact byte count, offsets, raw zero values or separation from Boot Status.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Archive full raw/decoded Type 32; report handle, type, length, six offset-indexed reserved bytes, separate Boot Status/additional data and pre/post byte diff.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The Reserved scope, Type 32 script and 5/5-minute values are retained; no firmware change is introduced.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Verify Type 32 length, extract exactly six reserved bytes at specification-defined offsets, require each byte to be 00h, preserve adjacent boot data separately, and repeat after reboot.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: SMBIOS systems containing Type 32 System Boot Information.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record SMBIOS, BIOS and raw-decoder/dmidecode versions.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Applicable SMBIOS Type 32 layout defining six Reserved bytes and following Boot Status data.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Replaces label grep with raw length-, offset- and byte-count-aware normative validation.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Detects non-zero individual bytes, truncated records and accidental inclusion of Boot Status that formatted grep can miss.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: Raw SMBIOS access and absent/multiple-record policy.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Decoded dmidecode text alone may omit raw reserved bytes; byte-preserving evidence is required.

project_override_considerations: A project may define Type 32 absence or multiplicity handling, but cannot override the normative zero requirement for reserved bytes in an applicable structure.
expected_evidence: Platform/SMBIOS/BIOS and decoder identity plus applicability policy
Complete pre-reboot raw Type 32 record(s) with handle/type/length
Six offset-indexed reserved bytes individually shown as 00h and Boot Status kept separate
Approved reboot/health evidence and complete post-reboot raw byte diff

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Reserved correctly identifies the six Type 32 bytes; the raw-byte method clarifies rather than changes the source intent.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Length, offset and zero-byte checks are deterministic and fully automatable once raw access is available.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Replaces fragile formatted grep with exact six-byte normative validation.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Retains its raw structure safeguards while restoring FULLY AUTOMATABLE capability under V3.1.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.v3_1_improvement: Treats package/raw access/reboot as readiness and preserves engineer verdict separately.

review_improvement: Makes the normative zero requirement auditable byte by byte and prevents Boot Status text or missing output from masquerading as Reserved evidence.
independent_technical_reasoning: The acceptance condition is an exact raw-byte equality test; it is intrinsically automatable and does not require an engineer's physical judgment.
